business_summary: Fujii Sangyo Corporation engages in the sale of electrical construction materials, electrical equipment, machine tools, information equipment, and civil engineering and construction machinery in Japan. It operates through Material Innovations Company, Infrastructure Solutions Company, Komatsu Construction Equipment Sales and Service Japan, Ltd., and Others segments. The company distributes lighting fixtures, electric wires, power distribution boards, air conditioners, ventilation fans, wiring and electrical circuit equipment, EV charging equipment, communication and video equipment, audio equipment, solar power generation systems, and energy storage equipment; network equipment, surveillance and security equipment, assembly hall equipment, electronic medical records and nurse call systems, IP phone and CATV equipment; and construction and plant equipment. It also installs and sells exterior wall materials, roofing materials, foundation structural materials, and civil engineering materials; develops and sells information processing systems and software; computer equipment and office supplies; designs, constructs, and maintains information-related equipment; and designs and constructs industrial buildings. In addition, the company sells control and power distribution equipment, electronic equipment, semiconductors, environmental equipment, various production materials, industrial robots, various machine tools, machining centers, and press machines; designs and manufactures automatic control panels and automated equipment; and design, construction, maintenance, and security management services. Further, it engages in the provision of lighting design, energy conservation support, electrical equipment, and consulting; sale, maintenance, and rental of construction machinery; product repair and after-sale services; and solar power generation, including ground and roof installation. Fujii Sangyo Corporation was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Fujii Sangyo Corporation은 일본에서 전기 건축 자재, 전기 장비, 공작 기계, 정보 장비, 토목 공학 및 건설 기계 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. Material Innovations Company, 인프라 솔루션 회사, Komatsu Construction Equipment Sales and Service Japan, Ltd. 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 조명 기구, 전선, 배전반, 에어컨, 환기 팬, 배선 및 전기 회로 장비, EV 충전 장비, 통신 및 비디오 장비, 오디오 장비, 태양광 발전 시스템, 에너지 저장 장비를 유통합니다. 네트워크 장비, 감시 및 보안 장비, 집회장 장비, 전자 의료 기록 및 간호사 호출 시스템, IP 전화 및 CATV 장비; 건설 및 플랜트 장비. 또한 외벽자재, 지붕자재, 기초구조자재, 토목자재 등을 설치 및 판매하고 있습니다. 정보 처리 시스템 및 소프트웨어를 개발 및 판매합니다. 컴퓨터 장비 및 사무용품; 정보 관련 장비를 설계, 구성 및 유지 관리합니다. 디자인하고 시공하고
